releaseNotes: NChat 1.0.53 — the composer's + now opens the camera and sends your position. Camera takes a photo with the phone's own camera UI, then it goes through the same path as a picked photo: EXIF (including the GPS tag) stripped, re-encoded, thumbnail generated, uploaded with a real progress ring. Location resolves a fix from the platform LocationManager — a recent cached one instantly, otherwise a single fresh fix with a nine-second budget — and sends lat,lng as a location message that stays queued when you are offline. Location bubbles show the coordinates and open in Maps on a tap; anything that is not a position still renders as a plain card instead of pretending.
